notes: TWO GENERATIONS LIKELY MERGED (research 2026-07-03): this tree's single record (b. 1644 Hartford, d. 18 Jan 1713 Hartford) matches, nearly date-for-date, the independently documented Zachariah Sanford (1644-1713/14) — son of the actual Hartford immigrant Robert Sanford (c. 1615/16-1676, from Much Hadham, Hertfordshire, Pequot War veteran), per WikiTree (Sanford-688, Sanford-271) and foundersofhartford.org. Robert Sr. himself died in 1676, not 1713. This tree's "Robert Zachariah Sanford" appears to conflate father and son into one person; recommend splitting into Robert Sanford Sr. (d. 1676) and his son Zachariah Sanford (1644-1713), with daughter Sarah Sanford (Paine, I182541964338) re-attached under Zachariah rather than Robert Sr.
